segments: It WAS twenty. You said you'd pay me back last Friday. You didn't. Now it's thirty.
You got Cash App? Venmo? Zelle? Put it on a kite and fly it over my house! Tie it to a pigeon! I'll take it in quarters. I just want my money.
I deliver food for a living, Dre. Last night I dropped off large wings and cheese fries. Guess whose house it was.
